issue_context.title: media_player.unjoin throws error when unjoining the "master"
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When using `media_player.unjoin` to unjoin multiple Sonos players in a single action, the result is a read timeout error on whichever Sonos player was the "master" when the group was created.  The now deprecated  `sonos.unjoin` service does not have this issue.  Example YAML, log, and diagnostic info' is attached.


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.6.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Media Player (or possibly Sonos)

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/media_player/

### Diagnostics information

I am using a service provided my Media Player integration, but the log is indicating there might be involvement with the Sonos integration, so I am attaching the Sonos integration diagnostics.

[config_entry-sonos-d9f29d20b8f14672843804fa8587b0ff.json.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/8834730/config_entry-sonos-d9f29d20b8f14672843804fa8587b0ff.json.txt)
.

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
service: media_player.unjoin
data: {}
target:
  entity_id:
    - media_player.sonos_upstairs
    - media_player.sonos_move
    - media_player.sonos_roam
    - media_player.sonos_great_room
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
TTPConnectionPool(host='192.168.1.124', port=1400): Read timed out. (read timeout=9.5) (unknown_error)
homeassistant.components.sonos.exception.SonosUpdateError: Error calling SonosSpeaker.unjoin on Move: HTTPConnectionPool(host='192.168.1.227', port=1400): Read timed out. (read timeout=9.5)
```


### Additional information

Please note that the above YAML works fine with the `sonos.unjoin` service (which is now deprecated). The problem seems to be with the speaker in the group that is the "master".  When grouping Sonos speakers, you start with one speaker (the "master") and add others to it.   By experimenting, I noticed that media_player.unjoin will consistently throw this timeout error for whichever speaker was the master.   The above log shows the error for my `media_player.sonos_move ` because I added the others to that one when the group was created, but if I started with the `media_player.sonos_great_room `, and added the others to that one, then `media_player.sonos_great_room` would throw the timeout error.

Submitted a PR that fixes this problem in local testing.

There is a slight behavior difference between `sonos.unjoin` and `media_player.unjoin` that I'd like to address separately. The former would optimize the order in which speakers were unjoined to better preserve old playqueues, but that's not possible with the new call.
